Do not use mid-session for final judgments, without reviewed evidence, as a hidden playbook runner, or to write owner truth.

Preserve raw custody and separate artifact creation from publication. Do not use for memo writeback, session mining, direct publication execution, durable-memory authority, or ordinary prose editing.
skills.short_description: Steward source authority or safe derivatives

skills.name: aoa-memo-writeback
skills.description: PATH GATE: copy the host-appended `(file: .../SKILL.md)` locator verbatim for the first read; never construct `.system` or `$CODEX_HOME` paths. If one constructed path has already failed with not-found before any other action, recover exactly once by reading the host locator and report `package_path_recovered`; never search or probe again. FIRST-WRITEBACK ONLY: use before any memo artifact exists to turn live-session, closeout, landed-work, PR, diff, or review evidence into one guarded candidate/export/no-write decision. If an existing candidate, export, quarantine packet, memory object, corpus identity, lifecycle target, or read-model target is named or supplied, select aoa-memo directly. Do not use for eval mining, raw session maintenance, generic harvest, durable memory, owner intake/review, recall, or proof.
skills.short_description: Create or decline the first memo writeback

skills.name: aoa-session-harvest

skills.short_description: Diagnose failure and run bounded recovery
